parameters.name: AutoCreateRepo
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically create repositories in the namespace. Valid values:

\-`  true `: automatically creates repositories in the namespace.

\-`  false `: does not automatically create repositories in the namespace.

parameters.name: DefaultRepoType
parameters.description:
The default repository type. Valid values:

*   `PUBLIC`: a public repository
*   `PRIVATE`: a private repository

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-chart-namespace --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --namespace-name namespace01 --auto-create-repo true --default-repo-type PUBLIC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateChartNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceName namespace01 --DefaultRepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --AutoCreateRepo true
